empty.heading: No curriculum yet
empty.body: Nothing has been planned for this mission. One press and an agent maps it into modules, fundamentals first, with every lesson named up front.
empty.then: It writes the plan and no lessons — you ask for those one at a time afterwards.

module.noOutcome: The curriculum didn't record an outcome for this module.

lesson.fundamental: {count, plural, one {# lesson builds on this} other {# lessons build on this}}
lesson.bridge: Bridge lesson, no day of its own

outcomes.unrecorded: {count, plural, one {# finished with no outcome} other {# finished with no outcome}}

mission.notPlanned: {count, plural, one {# module has no lessons planned yet, so it is not in this count} other {# modules have no lessons planned yet, so they are not in this count}}

adjustment.bridgeUnnamed: A smaller step toward an earlier lesson
adjustment.harder: Pitched a step above the plan

upcoming.bridge: The next lesson will be a smaller step toward {title}, because it landed too hard.
upcoming.harder: The next lesson will be pitched a step harder: {a} and {b} both landed too easy.

exam.afterLessons: Exam: written once every lesson here is done.
exam.notWritten: Exam: not written yet. Ask for the next thing and it will be.
exam.noItems: Exam: written, with nothing in it to pass.
exam.notSat: {total, plural, one {Exam: # item, not sat yet.} other {Exam: # items, not sat yet.}}
exam.passed: {total, plural, one {Exam passed: # of # item.} other {Exam passed: all # items.}}
exam.selfReported: {count, plural, one {# of those passes is self-reported.} other {# of those passes are self-reported.}}

projection.afterUnplanned: No projection: an earlier module has no lessons planned yet.
projection.atYourPace: At your pace, the exam lands on {date}.

schedule.heading: Schedule

schedule.calendar: {count, plural, one {# week} other {# weeks}}, {from} – {to}. Lessons on days 1–5, the exam on day 6.
